name: Talent Search (Virginia Tech)
what_you_do: Get free help to reach college. You get career ideas, tutoring, study tips, money help, ACT and SAT prep, campus visits and help with applications.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 6 to 12 at listed schools. They include Blacksburg High, Auburn High, Christiansburg High and Eastern Montgomery High. It mostly serves students who are first in their family to go to college and have lower family income. Any student who needs college prep help may join.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Now link on the Talent Search page if you attend a listed school. A Spanish application PDF is also posted.
notes: Not a job. It is a free college access program. Out-of-school and adult learners have a separate application.
